# Components MOC

UI component library sourced from [21st.dev](https://21st.dev), curated by Purabh.
When designing frontends, remix and adapt these — never invent UI from scratch.

| Folder | Count | What's in it |
|--------|-------|-------------|
| `Heroes/` | 3 | Hero sections, landing headers |
| `Navigation/` | 9 | Navbars, menus, dock, pagination, FAB |
